name: m5-zd-specialized
description: Control for [scala/scala#11367](https://github.com/scala/scala/pull/11367), with the condition that makes it matter: `stream` plus one generated source of 40 `@specialized` classes (`extra/Specialized.scala`, scripts/make-specialized.sh). SpecializeTypes then types the specialized variants' bodies with a Duplicators, a third Analyzer subclass, and the typechecker's `invokeinterface` calls through its self type go megamorphic. Zinc 1.12.1, one compile, only the Scala differs. The PR's measurement: the itable stub 10.5% of cycles on 2.13.x, 1.3% with the PR. Plain `stream` (m5-zd-control) shows no such change: its itable stub is about 1.4% of cycles either way.

variantDescriptions.tip: Zinc 1.12.1, Scala at the tip (6101d22), which has [scala/scala#11367](https://github.com/scala/scala/pull/11367): the typechecker's calls to its analyzer are invokevirtual, not invokeinterface
